sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Quiz Trivia: Guess the Animal, Music, Flags are centered around three main activities: guessing animals, identifying flags, and recognizing music. Each activity has its own set of questions, and you'll need to use your knowledge and skills to solve them.

Animal guessing is perhaps the most challenging aspect of the game. You'll be given a series of clues about an animal, and you'll need to use your knowledge of animals to guess what it is. The clues can range from physical characteristics to habitats, and you'll need to think critically to figure out the answer.

Flag identification is another key aspect of the game. You'll be shown a flag from a particular country, and you'll need to identify the country based on the flag's design and colors. This requires a good knowledge of world geography and flags, as well as the ability to recognize patterns and symbols.

Music recognition is perhaps the most fun aspect of the game. You'll be played a short clip of a song, and you'll need to identify the artist and song title. This requires a good knowledge of music, as well as the ability to recognize melodies and rhythms.

Overall, the gameplay mechanics of Quiz Trivia are engaging and challenging, making it perfect for anyone looking for a fun and educational puzzle game.
